roots.intent: Downloaded corpora, standards data, game records, table sets, source authority snapshots, and acceptance fixtures.
roots.identity_requirement: Every admitted asset receives a source-scoped manifest with exact bytes or a reproducible file-tree receipt, license, acquisition lineage, and version state.

roots.intent: Conventional model snapshots, tokenizers, tensor containers, GGUF artifacts, code corpora, Stack-derived data, Tiny-Codes, and independent model-runtime fixtures.
roots.identity_requirement: Every admitted snapshot and corpus partition retains provider, repository or dataset revision, exact file identity, license, lineage, and model or dataset family relationships.

roots.intent: Verified upstream Git source trees selected by dependencies/lock.json, outside the repository and without Git submodules.
roots.identity_requirement: Each tree must match its exact revision, Git archive digest, clean status, and license-file digests before use.

roots.intent: Out-of-tree builds, logs, generated artifacts, installed product, custom PostgreSQL and geometry stack, native libraries, tools, headers, and activation assets.
roots.identity_requirement: Installed files are observations until an activation manifest binds path, full hash, ABI closure, build receipt, and runtime capability checks.

roots.intent: IntelLLVM, oneMKL, oneTBB, compiler runtimes, profiling tools, and selected oneAPI acceleration providers.
roots.identity_requirement: Selected compiler and runtime versions, real paths, object hashes, flags, ISA, threading, numerical controls, and licenses enter package and execution receipts.
